prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1040; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was on a multi-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, near a shopping center. I was trying to change lanes to make a turn.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I checked my mirror, saw the lane looked clear, and signaled. I started moving over, and then I heard a horn and felt the impact on my driver's side as the other car came up alongside me.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?

A: Not that I recall. It was in a blind spot, I think. I didn't see it until the contact.

Q: How fast were you traveling?

A: Probably around the posted limit, maybe a little slower because traffic was heavy.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I hit my head on the window frame and I've had a bad headache since. I was dizzy at the scene and my doctor has diagnosed me with a concussion. I've been told to rest and avoid screens for a while.

Q: Did you receive medical treatment at the scene or afterward?

A: The paramedics checked me at the scene, and I went to the emergency room later that day. I've had a follow-up appointment since then.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want to be clear I was signaling and moving slowly. I'm still dealing with symptoms, so I may need to follow up if anything changes.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
